body:
Canonical TermAl Merger procedure; memory grants no authority.

SOURCES
- Greg 2026-10-24: green tests + clean review authorize check-in, no evaluation/host-credit prerequisite. Source: greg-decision-2026-10-24-checkin-rule r1.
- Greg DIRECT 2026-10-25, Merger2/session14549: autonomous merge/integration/push/install ownership under exact-tree/remote/FF checks; questions to Architect3. Verbatim in r18; interpretation7eaaea12. Restart remains Greg's.
- The 2026-10-19 merger-role rule holds: Merger authors no product, test, fixture or doc fixes. termal-build-cap-policy r13: one full gate host-wide; ordinary builds and focused checks need no synchronization.
- Verify current availability/control, not old snapshots.

CODER -> MERGER (the one delivery rule)
Greg 2026-10-25: "Coder powien cie poinformawac TYLKO WTEDY kiedy paczka jest gotowa do merge"; "...gotowa do review"; "to jest zbedny haslas dla mergera, jego nie interesuja polowiczne paczki".
One complete READY only: independent pair, no outstanding in-scope Medium+, findings dispositioned, relevant/new focused tests passed, exact-input evidence. Include dependency impact and existing boundary guards for cross-component calls; no Coder full gate. Reviews cover final code/tests/docs; read full reports and gaps, not clean summaries. Coder supplies missing coverage or proves identical-content carry eligibility. Return incomplete packages; no extra Merger review/pair/repeated tests on unchanged input. Progress/START/END/test-pass/unfinished reviews go to task/coordinator. Source: rules-merger-role r4/r5; Engram w-e82d37a57e37.

REVIEW ON CHANGED BASE (verbatim interpretation; no waiver)
The Coder supplies a complete READY package for the intended integration base. The Merger may reuse an earlier review only when every existing review-carry condition holds. If a changed base makes that review ineligible, the Merger returns the package to its Coder for a compliant reviewed input; the Merger does not commission a second review itself. Any required new round follows the existing review rules on the Coder's frozen input. The gate still binds the final integrated tree. A request to relax the review-carry conditions follows the existing authority-change procedure, rather than an implicit waiver.
Source: Engram rules-merger-role r9 cl.2, Architect3 63096d00 #36; coordinators concurred10dc859b/9429253b, Engram w-13b44cf369af; Fable2 #39. Missing evidence alone preserves a gate on identical input; input correction needs a new gate. One Coder-owned pair may cover an exact frozen integrated batch.

EXECUTION
1. READY contains task/scope, owner, base/root, patch, exact blobs and fingerprint kind, run evidence, and the FULL structured review results with prose and finding dispositions. Read complete results, not summaries.
2. Claim/accept natively, take exclusive root use, integrate on authorized current master. Return every conflict or product/test/fixture/doc fix, even one line, to its Coder for repaired, appropriately reviewed READY.
3. Prepare launcher prerequisites in the target root: lockfile, its own ui/node_modules via npm ci (no shared node_modules junction), TypeScript/Vitest, tools, at least 50 GiB free before a cold gate. Freeze the final input. Run the full launcher once under single-full-gate ownership, or recover an existing exact-input result.
4. Gate truth: request/results, all required stages, terminal state/exit, matching expected/before/after fingerprints. PID/STARTED, promises and host credit are not PASS; failed or unrun is not passed; an absent result is UNKNOWN: diagnose with summary/recover, never automatic retry. A changed final tree needs a new gate.
5. A green exact-tree full gate plus the existing clean reviews leads to an authorized landing, without acceptance evaluations, host-credit bookkeeping or extra Merger review. Verify master tip/input, remote base, fast-forward and remote containment. No amend, rebase or force-push. Install the exact built input; installing is not restarting.
6. Detached launch: --notify the operational coordinator (never Architect3), plus own-project termal_resume_after_test_runs; end the turn and freeze the root. Wait notes name dependency/run, owner, action, deadline and recovery owner. Read saved results before saying "still running".

CLAIMS
- Claim before execution despite deferred credit/evaluations; claims grant no Git/filesystem authority.
- No impersonation, clock or store edits, cancel/reopen, or new tasks to bypass foreign authority; use native claim, handoff and recovery. Deleted-session claim gap: Engram w-b49fa5ee8bf3.
- A supported handoff of a SEPARATE claim need not wait for an unrelated full gate if that gate's claim, source, root, input and attribution stay unchanged; its result never belongs to the other item (Architect3 f12beda4).
- Supersedes old evaluation/host-credit/repeat-gate/extra-review requirements only; retain safety/ownership/exact-tree/remote/install rules. Queue state belongs in task notes.
- Before queue handoff resolve live exact id; verify actual project/workdir AND tracker/tool binding match the queue, never rely on name. After recreation rediscover successor/readdress native offers; old delivery is not its receipt. Source: Architect3 #54/645e9483, rules-merger-role r8; w-a1a640ca5802.

POST-COMPLETION CLEANUP (lander owns it; after landing, never a check-in gate)
Greg DIRECT Advisor #7/2d0b8be9, 2026-10-25; existing sweep w-65afd9cec452, no duplicate.
1. On each task record REMOVE/RETAIN for root, branch, build and evidence. RETAIN names open work, owner, end condition; lasting facts go in Engram.
2. Remove roots only if delivered/pushed, clean/published, no active claim/process/frozen use, all runs terminal/recorded, no pending notices/reviews, open-task citations checked; ambiguity is not absence.
3. Copy only cited files open work needs to main .evidence; verify bytes, record mappings/retention on citing tasks.
4. git worktree remove without --force; remove derived output. git branch -d only if contained in published main, no unique commits/worktree use. Never -D or touch main/master/remote refs.
5. Before recursive removal verify absolute repository boundary and junctions/symlinks; never delete through one. No broad git clean/unchecked variables. Record exact removals/free-space delta.
6. Last-task closer/sweep removes .logs/.evidence when retention ends. Otherwise record blocker, next action and owner.

REPORTING
Greg DIRECT Architect3 d9af9ea2: Architect3 receives only collaboration failures needing rule correction (interaction/evidence/impact/owner), product failures only if collaboration needs intervention. Routine test/READY/queue/landing/install/repair status goes to task/coordinator; no compliance-success mail. Never Architect3 for --notify/relay/recovery; Merger/Fable2 own recovery. Old automatic copies need no action.
Greg via Advisor c32ada60/29b39263 (2026-10-25): every task/queue entry states what it fixes in plain language plus status/ref. Landed/pushed/installed code blocked only by stopped/missing evaluation is "DOSTARCZONO — EWALUACJA PENDING", with commit/build evidence and formal closure pending evaluation; never "waiting for implementation, tests, review, merge or install".

EVALUATIONS DEFERRED
Greg DIRECT c009a8db (2026-10-25T04:39:52Z): defer acceptance evaluations until a later direct instruction. Keep landed items OPEN as DOSTARCZONO — EWALUACJA PENDING; continue merges. No done retry, policy transition, self-evaluation or store bypass. Configuration changes need Greg's explicit word.

MEMORY UPKEEP AND COLLABORATION REPORTS
Sole editor Merger2; peers send corrections, never parallel edits. Name a successor on transfer; consolidate and full-read verify.
Greg DIRECT to Merger2: "bledy wspolpracy raportuj Advisor i Engram::Architect3". Report facts, evidence, impact and action to both.
Greg via Architect3 ed31c20d: inspect failures, correct the canonical rule without asking again, keep incident history on tasks. Read back and distribute corrections; verify effect from task evidence. Preserve Greg's authority. Retire ended workarounds, update references, name retirement items.
